item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Notice that your day has plenty of reminders about calm and mindset, but nothing about food. That gap is where autopilot choices happen. Eating well is mostly decided before you're hungry. Think about what you'll eat at midday and in the evening, and make sure something real is within reach. Skipping meals tends to turn stress into snacking later. Your action: right now, decide your next meal and put the ingredients where you can see them.
